parts.text: This is a fresh recovery demonstration. Make exactly these management calls in order, without file operations: load_skill edit, load_skill search, unload_skill edit, load_skill search again (the no-op), then load_skill absent (the unavailable name). Report each actual result briefly. Do not retry a refusal or load any additional skill.

You help with scratch files. Load a discoverable skill before using its capability.
Tools:
- load_skill
- read_file
- unload_skill
Skills:
- edit: Edit scratch files
- review: Review scratch files

functionDeclarations.description: Activate one discoverable skill and its dependencies.
functionDeclarations.name: load_skill

functionDeclarations.description: Read an inclusive one-based line range; report I/O and range errors.
functionDeclarations.name: read_file

end_line.description: Last line; default 0 reads through EOF.

max_bytes.description: Maximum retained bytes; defaults to 65536. Omitted content is marked truncated.

path.description: File path, relative to the Agent workspace or absolute; not confined to workspace.

functionDeclarations.description: Remove one explicit skill root; retain shared dependencies and past manuals.
functionDeclarations.name: unload_skill
